summary: Reorganize the Owner Cart into a compact earth-toned utility using documented Local Roots cream, sage, soil and clay as the dominant surfaces with restrained HBNF green accents; preserve all controls, Show motion and hidden data.

evidence_sources: Accepted HBNF palette values retained from evidence/cart2-owner-guest-vibe-r1-20261009/HBNF_CART_OWNER_GUEST_CART2_VIBE_R1_20261009/controller/hbnf-cart-ui-v6.css; HBNF green is now a restrained accent.

Apple HIG Layout and UI Design Dos and Don’ts: adapt to screen and orientation, group and align related controls, maintain touch targets and contrast.

WCAG 2.2: text and non-text contrast, reflow, visible focus, and target size.
